citations.claim: The component uses typer framework to create a CLI application with rich console output
MessariClient class manages authentication and HTTP requests to Messari API
The assets command provides crypto asset listing functionality
Format_number utility function provides consistent large number formatting with B/M/K suffixes
The metrics command displays price, volume, and market capitalization data
The timeseries command fetches historical data for specific asset metrics
Multiple output formats are supported including JSON, markdown, and rich terminal displays
The _request method handles HTTP communication with error handling and status code checking
Client initialization requires API key authentication via environment variables or direct parameter
External dependencies include httpx, typer, rich, and python-dotenv
The component supports both v1 and v2 Messari API endpoints
Several API endpoints have been deprecated, requiring fallback implementations
Raw command provides direct API access for advanced users with custom parameters
Component configuration includes centaur-specific module and secret definitions
The component integrates with centaur_sdk for table formatting and imports the MessariClient
